# The housekeeping of a database a clock that went back and a second
# user left (setup.sh): CleanupAdditionalUsers and
# FixFutureRunScheduledTasks. A recording of its own; same format as
# ../golden/requests.txt.
#
#   GOLDEN_SETUP=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-housekeeping/setup.sh \
#       GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-housekeeping/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-housekeeping make golden
#
# Neither repair shows in an answer: the tasks page reads the scheduler's
# cache, filled at start, and the users are not listed. db-after.json is
# what the database held after the recording, written by hand with
#
#   python3 -I scripts/housekeeping-snapshot.py .cache/sonarr/golden-data/sonarr.db \
#       tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-housekeeping/db-after.json
system-task-before GET /api/v3/system/task
command-housekeeping POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-housekeeping.json
sleep 10
command-housekeeping-get GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-housekeeping}
system-task-after GET /api/v3/system/task
